findings.description: The sign-in error message ('Invalid credentials', role=alert) is drawn with the same colour as its background (both var(--danger-bg)), so the text is invisible and the user sees an empty red box after a failed sign-in.
repro: Enter username viewer-d641 and a wrong password
The red alert box appears with no readable text

findings.description: The stylesheet sets outline: none on all focusable elements (*:focus, *:focus-visible) and provides no replacement focus style, so keyboard users cannot see which control has focus (links, buttons, the category select, inputs).
repro: Sign in as editor-ad69 and open /expenses at 1280 px
Observe the focused Edit link has no visible focus indicator
Repeat for Apply, Delete, Add expense and Sign out

findings.description: Submitting the Add expense form with a whitespace-only title (browser 'required' accepts it) is rejected by the server with a 400, but the page silently re-renders as a blank Add expense form at /expenses with no error message, and the typed values are cleared. The same silent blank re-render happens when the server rejects a negative amount, which the client-side min=0 normally prevents.
repro: Sign in as editor-ad69 and open /expenses/new
Type three spaces in Title and 12.00 in Amount
The form reloads empty at /expenses with no error text; no expense is added

findings.description: Amounts and the total of 1,000 or more are shown without thousands separators (for example '$1234567.89' in the row and 'Total: $1234985.38'), which is hard to read and inconsistent with usual currency formatting.
repro: Sign in as editor-ad69 and add an expense with amount 1234567.89
The amount cell shows $1234567.89 and the total shows without commas

findings.description: Every row's Delete button has the same accessible name 'Delete' with no reference to the expense it removes, so screen-reader users navigating by button cannot tell which expense each one deletes.
repro: Sign in as editor-ad69 and open /expenses
Use a screen reader or the accessibility tree to list buttons
Eight or more buttons are named only 'Delete'

notes: Tested at 1280 px desktop and 360 px mobile (Chromium) for viewer and editor: list, totals, category filter (total follows filtered rows), add, edit, delete, role gating (viewer gets 403 on /expenses/new and /expenses/1/edit), and mobile card layout (no horizontal overflow). Totals were correct throughout. Not tested: touch gestures beyond tap, real screen readers, other browsers, the Category filter on mobile, and pagination (none seen). Test data I created was deleted and the edited row restored afterwards.

cost.notes: estimate from 48475 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0005-$0.0058
